ingredients.item: olive oil, plus more to serve

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a wide, deep frying pan over medium heat until it shimmers.
Add the onion and pepper with a pinch of salt. Cook until soft and starting to colour.
Stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika, and chilli flakes. Cook for a minute, until fragrant.
Tip in the tomatoes and the salt. Crush any whole pieces against the side of the pan.
Simmer uncovered until the sauce thickens and a spoon leaves a clear trail across the pan.
Taste the sauce. Adjust with salt and pepper, and a pinch of sugar if it tastes sharp.
Make four wells in the sauce with the back of a spoon. Crack one egg into each well.
Cover and cook over low heat until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
Scatter over the feta and parsley, drizzle with olive oil, and serve from the pan with bread.
